hero.title: The talent is here. Now, so is the standard.
hero.subtitle: The story of an agency born in Yaoundé with a world-class bar.

story.p1: CDA was born from a simple observation: Cameroonian businesses deserve the same level of digital execution as those in Paris, London, or San Francisco.
story.p2: Findi founded CDA in Yaoundé with one conviction: the talent is here, the tools are now accessible — all that was missing was the standard.
story.p3: AI is changing the rules. For the first time, an SME in Yaoundé can operate with the precision of a multinational — with the right partner.
story.p4: The lion is not just a symbol. It's our standard: presence, patience, precision.

method.title: Measure, adjust, repeat
method.imageAlt: Illustration of an analytics dashboard: two rising lines, upward-trending metrics, and a channel breakdown panel.
method.caption: Every project starts by deciding what will be measured. Without that, 'it worked' is an impression rather than a result.
method.p1: We don't hand over a website and disappear. Before anything is built, we agree on the three numbers that will tell us whether the investment paid off — qualified enquiries, response time, conversion rate. Nothing else counts.
method.p2: Then we measure monthly, send you the numbers, and fix whatever isn't working. It's less dramatic than a new brand identity every quarter, and it's why our clients stay an average of two years.

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: Which data Cameroon Digital Agency collects, why we collect it, and how long we keep it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to answer you and do good work with you. This page says exactly which data, why, and for how long.

sections.heading: Who processes your data
paragraphs: Cameroon Digital Agency, established in Yaoundé, Cameroon, is responsible for the processing described here. One person concretely holds that responsibility: the founder. You can reach them directly through the contact form or on WhatsApp.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you give us voluntarily:
bullets: Contact details — name, company name, WhatsApp number, email address.
The content of your enquiries — what you write in our forms.
Technical data — pages viewed, so we can see what actually helps.
Testimonials — name, company and review that you choose to publish.

sections.heading: Why we use this data
paragraphs: To answer you, to present our services, and to keep our commitments. That's all. We don't sell your data and we don't share it with third parties for commercial purposes.
No automated decision-making, no profiling. A human reads every enquiry.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: An unconverted lead is kept for three months, then deleted. Project data is kept for the length of the working relationship, then five years — an accounting obligation. A published testimonial stays visible until you ask us to remove it.
You can shorten any of these periods at any time by asking us.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: See, correct, export or delete your data: all of it is possible, at any time, on request. You can also withdraw consent. We reply within 30 days.
If you believe our processing is improper, you can lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Your data travels over encrypted connections. It is stored with hosts located in Europe, where data protection regulation applies. Admin access is protected by an encrypted password and a time-limited session.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses a small number of cookies strictly required to operate. They are listed cookie by cookie in our cookie policy. Nothing here follows you across other sites.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. Significant changes are flagged on the site.

meta.title: Terms of service
meta.description: The conditions that govern all work between you and Cameroon Digital Agency.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The rules of the game, written plainly. If anything here is unclear, ask before you sign — we would always explain twice rather than end up in court.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: These terms govern the services of Cameroon Digital Agency: digital strategy, websites, brand identity, content, advertising, AI automation and related services.
By entrusting us with a project, you accept these terms. They also apply to the free strategy session, with one exception: nothing is payable there.

sections.heading: Quotes, pricing and payment
paragraphs: Every project gets a written quote, itemised, valid for thirty days. The quote is the reference: it sets out the scope, deliverables, timeline and price.

Payment terms are stated on the quote. We accept MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money and bank transfer. A deposit is required to begin production; it is non-refundable once the first deliverables are done.
Prices are in Central African CFA francs (XAF). Third-party costs — licences, domain names, hosting, advertising — are passed through to you at cost.

sections.heading: Timelines and delivery
paragraphs: Timelines start once we've received the deposit and everything we need from you: content, assets and access. A delay on your side moves the timeline by the same amount.
We commit to realistic working dates, not to promises. If something unexpected comes up, we tell you immediately and propose a plan B — never a bad surprise at the end of a project.

sections.heading: Revisions
paragraphs: Each stage includes the number of revisions stated on the quote. Beyond that, additional work is billed at our current hourly rate — always quoted and approved before we commit to it.

sections.heading: Your obligations
paragraphs: You provide the content, logos, access and information we need, and you confirm you hold the rights to it. You name a single point of contact, available within reasonable time.
We deliver original work. We will not reuse code or content you don't own the rights to.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: On completion of the project and full settlement of all invoices, the usage rights to the deliverables transfer to you.
We keep the right to show the project in our portfolio and communications, unless you explicitly ask us not to.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: We do everything reasonably possible to meet our commitments. We cannot, however, guarantee a specific commercial outcome: results also depend on your market, your offer and factors outside our control.
Our liability cannot exceed the total amount you have paid us for the project concerned.

sections.heading: Cancellation and refunds
paragraphs: You may stop a project at any time by notifying us in writing. Work already done and already committed to is billed; any deposit is non-refundable beyond the work carried out.
We may suspend a service if the project becomes impossible to deliver, or if agreed payment is not made. In that case we tell you first and we always look for a solution together.

sections.heading: Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Cameroonian law. Any dispute falls under the courts of Yaoundé.
We would always rather talk it through. Write to us first: most misunderstandings are settled in a single message.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: These terms may evolve. The version that applies is the one in force when the quote is signed.

meta.title: Cookie policy
meta.description: What the site stores in your browser, and why — no waffle.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: A cookie is a small text file the site leaves in your browser so it can remember something. Some are essential, others are optional. Here is exactly which, and why.

sections.heading: Strictly necessary cookies
paragraphs: They make the site work and cannot be switched off. No third-party tracking data is stored in them.
The site cannot function correctly without them.
bullets: cda_admin_session — keeps you signed in to the admin area.
NEXT_LOCALE — remembers your language choice so the site stays in the right language.

sections.heading: Audience measurement cookies
paragraphs: We measure anonymised data to find out which pages genuinely help. No advertising tracking, no profiling, no resale of data.
bullets: Audience measurement — visit counts and pages viewed, in aggregated and anonymous form.

sections.heading: Third-party cookies
paragraphs: Some services we use — booking appointments, for instance — set their own cookies. Their use is governed by their own privacy policies, which we don't control.
bullets: Cal.com — for booking slots from the contact page.

sections.heading: Managing your cookies
paragraphs: You can delete cookies at any time from your browser settings, and you can block optional cookies. The site stays usable, but some preferences reset on every visit.

sections.heading: How long they last
paragraphs: Session cookies are cleared when you close the browser or after eight hours of inactivity. The language cookie lasts up to a year. Audience measurement cookies are kept for thirteen months at most.
